newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Bank Ukraina, Bank of New York in custodial deal.
newsitem.headline: Bank Ukraina, Bank of New York in custodial deal.

text.p: Ukraine's largest bank has signed a custodial agreement with the Bank of New York, the chief of Bank Ukraina's investment department said on Monday.

"Our bank is the first Ukrainian commercial bank to achieve such a deal with the Bank of New York, which foresees that on behalf of our partner's order we can buy and administer any kind of transaction with a Ukrainian share," Alexander Okhrymenko said.

Ukraine, which plans to complete privatisation of medium- and large-scale enterprises this year, has become more attractive to foreign investment funds as an increasing number of government enterprises are sold.
Currently only several banks are licensed to purchase shares on behalf of foreign banks.
